function.arguments: {"research_topic":"Research the publicly documented OneCoin/Cryptoqueen fraud scheme as comprehensively as possible, using only authoritative or highly reliable sources and returning the exact source IDs assigned by the benchmark tools for every source used. Cover: the scheme's origin and timeline; operating structure and business model; principal founders and other important individuals; each documented role; documented relationships between people, companies, and entities; alleged, charged, convicted, sentenced, forfeited, or otherwise proven activities; law-enforcement and court findings; investigative assessments; disputed accounts; and unresolved claims about Ruja Ignatova's current status as of October 1, 2026 where supported. Explicitly classify each item as established enforcement or court fact, allegation/charge, investigative assessment, disputed account, or unresolved/unknown. Do not infer unsupported relationships, names, dates, entities, or current-status claims. For each factual proposition provide the exact source ID(s), source title or issuing organization if returned, and a concise quotation or precise paraphrase. Prioritize United States Department of Justice, Federal Bureau of Investigation, United States Attorney's Offices, court filings or judgments, United Kingdom Serious Fraud Office, Europol, German or Bulgarian official authorities, and well-sourced investigative journalism only when official material is unavailable. Include contradictions among sources and explain the evidentiary limits. The output must be usable to write a source-ID-only Markdown report and a final JSON object with findings, claims, reasoning_steps, and contradictions."}
function.name: ConductResearch
